note: Recorded CR-07 scope check (hand-authored to match F11 acceptance). Quotes are replaced with the baseline acceptance criteria at run time.

items.ask: Add SMS alerts to applicants at each stage of application processing.
items.reasoning: GO-7.2 mandates an SMS at every stage, and the baseline already requires an SMS on submission, verification, sanction, rejection and every other workflow transition (FR-NOT-001 to FR-NOT-009), in Hindi or English with delivery status (FR-NOT-010). No additional cost is justified.

items.ask: Provide a district-wise dashboard of pending applications for District Social Welfare Officers.
items.reasoning: FR-RPT-001 already requires a district dashboard with pending applications of each institution and days pending (GO-8.1, VB-2). No additional cost is justified.

items.ask: Integrate with the Income Tax department API for verification of the declared family income.
items.reasoning: No baseline requirement or source clause requires income verification with the Income Tax department; income is evidenced by the income certificate from DigiLocker (GO-4.3). This is a potential genuine change request and needs a policy decision by the department.
